snippet.title: WAKESURFER: Get Gnarly! | Free Wakesurf Game Trailer (Phone & PC)
snippet.description:
The first real wakesurfing game, designed by a wakesurfer. 16 levels: lakes, a wave park, mountain rapids, a tropical lagoon, rivers, barrels, the Mega Yacht and a desert lake where you swap boats.

- Spins, lip slides, big airs, barrels and combos
- Earn or buy better boards, gear and boats
- Weekly leaderboards
- Phone or PC (keyboard or Xbox controller)

Free to play, optional upgrades:
https://wakesurfer.mitchell-gaming.com

Code YTWAKE = 500 free coins (Settings → HAVE A CODE?)

Levels in this video: Local Lake, Wave Park, Rapids, Lagoon, River, Night River, Barrel Run, Mega Yacht
Music: "Surf's Up" from the game's soundtrack

#wakesurf #wakesurfing #indiegame
